people.role: Banner man of the spring-flood rafts
people.appearance: Carries a rolled green banner on his shoulder even indoors.
people.backstory: Đằng Bích Lưu's (dang_bich_luu) first raftsman from her own Thủy Ma Thôn, he carries the green banner at the front of the spring rafts. He has written twice to Hồng Lô about a pill for Lục Lưu Mộc (luc_luu_moc), signing his master's name, and Hồng Lô now believes she owes it a favour she knows nothing of.

people.role: Warden of the poacher watch at Việt Quất Thôn
people.appearance: Glances at every cart wheel as if pricing it.
people.backstory: She walks the poacher watch under Lại Hoành Chi (lai_hoanh_chi) and agrees the hall is underpaid. She thinks the eastern woods should sell past the lord as he says, and has told him she will carry the next log herself. She has already given him the hall's raft schedule, which Lục Thanh Sam trusted her to keep.

ties.note: her warden; of his party in the hall

people.role: Works the seedbeds with old Phú Hậu Thổ
people.appearance: A seed-husk tucked behind each ear.
people.backstory: Bạch Lạp-born, she tends the seedbeds beside Phú Hậu Thổ (phu_hau_tho), who has taught her more than her master has. Each spring she goes with Mi Túc Thụ (mi_tuc_thu) to look for the Grandmother Fir's seedlings.

people.appearance: Plain as a pot-lid, she says herself before anyone else can; her singing turns every head on the river.
people.backstory: Her brother Sầm Ngưu Tất (sam_nguu_tat) brings the logs down from the boom for Thúy Vi; she rides them down to it for the hall. They meet at Tân Cư Thôn each autumn and sing on the river louder than anyone.

people.role: Takes the spirit honey at night in the hornet valley
people.appearance: Hornets single him out of any crowd; welts under both eyes, honey-gourds clinking at his belt.
people.backstory: Nghệ Hoàng Phong (nghe_hoang_phong) took him into the hornet valley after he was stung forty times as a boy and lived. He is the one man who takes the spirit honey now, and he no longer swells.

people.role: Carries the hall's tallies for the dying Lục Lưu Mộc
people.appearance: Fidgets with a notched tally-stick when he thinks.
people.backstory: He keeps the hall's end of the tallies now that Lục Lưu Mộc's (luc_luu_moc) hands shake. He has found a notch in the 1199 tally that no log matches, and has not yet asked Lại Hoành Chi (lai_hoanh_chi) about it.

people.role: Lại Hoành Chi's newest disciple; Bỉnh Thiết Phủ's friend
people.appearance: Split lip, crooked grin; the grin never reaches his eyes.
people.backstory: He rode his First Raft to the boom at Tân Cư Thôn the same spring as Bỉnh Thiết Phủ (binh_thiet_phu), and is the one Bỉnh told who handed his father to the Hall of Rules. His own master is that man, Lại Hoành Chi (lai_hoanh_chi). He skims a copper off each log he tallies, as his master taught him, and Lục Lưu Mộc's (luc_luu_moc) tallies come out a notch short.
